Completed `DES043-TrackTech-01` at input revision `b564308fe2e76da42d0d62c6ba33f9c76876119c`.

Written: [TrackTech dossier]([redacted]

- Proposed 12 V aggregation, ≤14 modules/feed, 8–10 mm² LV conductors, 8 mm cable envelope; preserve HV isolation and fibre capacity.
- Local 12 × 0.17 mm² rails pass the warm-resistivity screen: 185.7 mV return drop. Thinner 0.15 mm fails.
- Retained finite pickup footprints and tube dimensions; two cooling circuits/petal, 5/7 g/s nominal/adverse.
- Required module redesign includes ASIC/interconnect arrangement, thermal windows, direct pipe inserts and 0.35 mm spreader.
- Conditional thermal screen gives −21.08 °C adverse maximum at −35 °C coolant, including distributed leakage allowance.
- Source metadata supplied for CERN converter and Henkel interface datasheets.

Whitespace and numerical assertions passed. ASIC feasibility, cable qualification, cold interface properties, structural performance and two-phase hydraulics remain engineering gates; no acceptance or sign-off claimed.
